name: proto-default-roots-import-unresolved-beside-a-resolved-one
description: With no buf.yaml and no proto.import_paths, a file one of whose imports resolves under no root fails as protoc fails it, though its other import resolves and supplies the types its service names: the file publishes nothing and carries an unresolved-import note. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
